history.overview: The Barricades form the Muramite Legion’s strongest defensive line, reinforced with siege engines and Discord‑warped fortifications.

timeline.name: Barricades Constructed
timeline.description: Muramite engineers built reinforced defensive structures.

timeline.name: Siege Platforms Added
timeline.description: Raised platforms were added to support siege engines.

timeline.name: Resistance Breach Attempts
timeline.description: Resistance forces launched repeated attempts to break the barricades.
